eyebrow: Lesson 15 · B1 · Being a Good Guest · 20 câu
heading: In Someone Else's Home
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Being a Good Guest – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 12–15.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Being a Good Guest (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: When you visit a friend, stay with them. Don't {wander off|wander off} around the house on your own, opening doors to see what is behind them.

paras.label: B
paras.text: If you use the bathroom, do not open the cupboards or look in the drawers. It is not nice to be {nosy|nosy}. Staying for a {sleepover|sleepover} and forgot your toothpaste? Simply ask your host if you can use some of theirs, rather than searching for it.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Every family has its own {house rules|house rules}, and they may be different from the rules in your home. Perhaps shoes are not allowed upstairs, or nobody eats in the living room. If you are not sure, just ask. Following the rules shows respect for the whole family.

paras.label: D
paras.text: Always {tidy up|tidy up} after yourself. Put toys away after you play with them, and leave the bathroom {as clean as a whistle|as clean as a whistle}. Accidents happen, of course. If you break something, say how sorry you are and offer to fix it or {replace|replace} it.

paras.label: E
paras.text: At a sleepover, remember that other people want to sleep. Late at night, {whisper|whisper} and walk quietly. Don't {stomp|stomp} around like a dinosaur, or you might wake the whole house up!

vocab.vi: đi lang thang ra chỗ khác

parts.title: Part 1 · Matching headings
parts.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp cho mỗi đoạn. Mỗi tiêu đề dùng một lần.
options: Every home has its own rules

items.label: Paragraph A
items.why: Đoạn A: ở cạnh bạn, không đi lang thang.

items.label: Paragraph B
items.why: Đoạn B: không lục tủ trong phòng tắm (*nosy*).

items.label: Paragraph C
items.why: Đoạn C: mỗi nhà có **house rules** riêng.

items.label: Paragraph D
items.why: Đoạn D: dọn dẹp, làm vỡ đồ thì xin lỗi và đền.

items.label: Paragraph E
items.why: Đoạn E: ban đêm nói nhỏ, đi nhẹ.

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: What does the writer say you should NOT do when visiting a friend?
options: explore the house on your own
questions.why: *Don't wander off around the house on your own.*

questions.q: If you forget your toothpaste, you should look for some in the bathroom drawers.
questions.why: Sai. *ask your host… rather than searching for it.*

questions.q: According to (C), what should you do if you don't know a family's rules?
options: Wait until someone tells you off.
questions.why: *If you are not sure, just ask.*

questions.q: Which example of a house rule is given in (C)?
options: Nobody eats in the living room.
Everyone must go to bed at eight.
questions.why: *…or nobody eats in the living room.*

questions.q: The writer says you should offer to fix or replace something you break.
questions.why: Đúng. *offer to fix it or replace it.*

questions.q: Why does the writer compare a noisy guest to a dinosaur in (E)?
options: to describe heavy, noisy footsteps in a funny way
because dinosaurs are popular at sleepovers
to suggest guests should play dinosaur games
because the host has a toy dinosaur
questions.why: Hình ảnh khủng long → bước chân nặng nề, ồn ào; cách nói hài hước.

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: What is the girl doing wrong?
options: looking inside her host's bathroom cabinet
questions.why: Đoạn B: *do not open the cupboards or look in the drawers.*
questions.alt: A girl opens a bathroom mirror cabinet and bottles fall out all around her head

questions.q: Which word from the text best describes the girl's behaviour?
questions.alt: A girl opens a bathroom mirror cabinet and bottles fall out all around her head

questions.q: Which paragraph gives advice for the child in this picture?
questions.why: Mặc đồ ngủ, dép khủng long, đánh chũm chọe → đoạn E: *Don't stomp around like a dinosaur.*
questions.alt: A child in spotty pyjamas and big dinosaur slippers bangs two cymbals together while a dog watches

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: Last Saturday I stayed at my friend Ava's house for the first time. [1] Before dinner, Ava's dad told me that nobody was allowed to eat upstairs. [2] Later that night, we wanted to giggle and tell stories, but everyone else was asleep. [3]
options: We ran up and down the stairs shouting until two o'clock in the morning.
I was excited but also a bit nervous because I didn't know her family well.
That was different from my house, but I followed the rule without complaining.
Ava's dad had broken his favourite mug that morning.
So we whispered under the blankets until we fell asleep.

items.why: Lần đầu ngủ lại → vừa háo hức vừa lo.
Phản ứng với **house rule** vừa được nêu.
Mọi người đã ngủ → thì thầm.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *…leave the bathroom as clean as a whistle* (D). **As clean as a whistle** means…
*Don't wander off around the house* (A). To **wander off** is to…
options: walk away from the group without a clear purpose
questions.why: **Wander off** = đi lang thang ra chỗ khác.

questions.q: *Don't stomp around like a dinosaur* (E). To **stomp** is to…
